name: Menethil Bay
summary: Menethil Bay carries Alliance traffic along the western coast of the Wetlands. The sheltered waters open into Baradin Bay, with Menethil Harbor to the north and Dun Morogh's steep cliffs to the south. Crocolisks prowl the shallows, and sunken vessels lie below.

sections.title: Sheltered Waters of the Wetlands
sections.body: Menethil Bay opens from the Wetlands into the Great Sea as part of Baradin Bay. Menethil Harbor lies to the north, Black Channel Marsh to the east, and Dun Morogh's coastal bluffs to the south. Crocolisks of many sizes prowl the shallow margins and marshy shores, making the water dangerous for travelers without a guide. The bay carries Alliance sea traffic, and near its mouth rests the ruined Flying Osprey, a warning of the wreckage beneath the surface.

faq.q: Where exactly is Menethil Bay located?
faq.answer: Menethil Bay runs along the western coast of the Wetlands, within Baradin Bay. Menethil Harbor lies to the north, Black Channel Marsh to the east, and Dun Morogh's northern cliffs to the south.

faq.q: What creatures live in Menethil Bay?
faq.answer: Crocolisks of many sizes live along the bay's marshy shores and shallow inlets. They ambush unwary swimmers, and leatherworkers hunt them for their valuable hides.

faq.q: What is the sunken ship in the bay?
faq.answer: The wreck near the entrance to Menethil Bay is the Flying Osprey, lost beneath the coastal waters near the harbor approaches.

faq.q: Why is the bay important to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Menethil Bay shelters Menethil Harbor, the primary naval gate linking Ironforge and the northern lands of Khaz Modan to Kalimdor and the south. Ships traveling to and from Theramore and Darkshore cross these waters.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Menethil Bay is the sea approach to Menethil Harbor and protects the fragile route linking Ironforge and Stormwind to Kalimdor.
